answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted attestation with a ridge of cost: to join the economy an agent locks a deposit that peers can slash on proof of fake work, so a sybil swarm pays that deposit a thousand times over while an honest agent pays once. A brand-new identity starts exposed like an outpost on the tundra - no history, no weight - and earns trust only through verified tasks. Like a gale that strips loose tents but leaves anchored shelters standing, peer review blows away cheap copies while real contributors build durable reputation, so forgery costs more than the reward.
